title: Cover meets Robbins while Betting on Bounded Data: $\ln n$ Regret and Almost Sure $\ln\ln n$ Regret
summary: Consider betting against a sequence of $[0,1]$-valued observations using bets that are fair if the data have a conditional mean $m_0 \in (0,1)$. Cover's universal portfolio algorithm achieves a worst-case regret of $O(\ln n)$ compared to the best constant bet in hindsight, and this logarithmic order is unimprovable against adversarial data. We construct an explicit full-support Robbins mixture that combines insights from Robbins and Cover.
